svg.title: InsightBoard CRM — 08 — InsightBoard Connected Table ERD

text.tspan: No stored references to another entity
Cardinality is printed at each entity end: 1 = exactly one · 0..1 = optional one · 0..N = zero or many · 1..N = one or more.
Each entity appears once. Dashed recordId branches are mutually exclusive by resource (XOR); a historical target may no longer exist.
ID = document identifier · REF = logical reference · UQ = unique schema index. Project.dealId requires the unique partial index, including archived projects.
